arc: Little traces a smooth electric signal into a moving speaker cone, sees vibration in rice on a bowl and drum, follows it through a cup telephone, and wonders how an air wave reaches an ear.
designLocks: warm paper and ink with rare gold
Big and Little share a gaze

scenes.intent: At a cozy kitchen craft table in soft lamplight, Big and Little Wonderer lean toward a small intact walnut speaker with a visible cream paper cone on its front. A notebook holds a simple smooth wave drawing. A few delicate muted orange curved air-wave marks travel away from the cone. Quiet curiosity, one scene, no text.

Close three-quarter view of the front of a small intact walnut speaker on the craft table. Its broad cream paper cone is shown mid vibration with two subtle offset contour marks suggesting forward and backward movement, and delicate curved air-wave marks radiating outward. Big and Little watch side by side behind the speaker. No visible inner electrical parts or text.

Big and Little Wonderer watch a cream ceramic bowl on a wooden tray. Transparent plastic wrap is stretched taut over the rim. A pinch of rice rests on top, with three grains just barely hopping above the membrane. Big gently touches the bowl side. Soft lamp light catches the transparent taut surface. An open notebook nearby, no text.

A small toy drum rests flat on a wooden craft table with a pinch of rice on its pale taut drumhead. Big gently touches the outer drum rim while Little watches three rice grains make tiny hops over the surface. Big and Little share the same gaze. Folded linen and a warm lamp, no drumsticks, no text.

Big and Little Wonderer use a simple cup-and-string telephone across a cozy craft table. Big holds one cream paper cup near the mouth, Little holds the second near the ear. A single gently taut string connects the centers of the two cup bottoms, crossing only above the table. No string around bodies. Notebook with tiny wave sketches, warm lamp, no electricity, no text.

Quiet over-the-shoulder scene beside Little Wonderer and Big at the kitchen table. A small intact walnut speaker faces toward Little, with delicate curved air-wave marks approaching Little’s small rounded ear. Big shares Little’s gaze toward an open notebook that shows a simple ear outline and smooth wave sketch. Tender warm lamplight, wonder held in the unfinished drawing, no written text.
